title: requirements.yaml
description: The requirements sheet: the facets of the order, each with its value, unit and sources, and the derived values, your predictions for a replica built to your own BOM. submission_contract.md, section 2, gives the rules in words.

facets.description: 1 to 20 facets. No facet id may appear twice: schema_check.py checks this rule, which the schema does not state.

id.description: One of the facet ids of submission_contract.md, section 2.1.

value.description: The value of the facet: a finite number in the unit of the facet.

mass_kg.description: Mass of a replica with your BOM and the pod.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

front_axle_load_n.description: Static load on the front axle of that replica.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

scan_plane_height_mm.description: Height of the LiDAR scan plane of that replica.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

ground_clearance_mm.description: Ground clearance of that replica: the height of its lowest point, wheels and tyres left out of account.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

envelope_height_mm.description: Height of the highest point of that replica.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

steering_torque_nm.description: Torque the steering servo of that replica must give to turn the front wheels at standstill.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

lock_time_s.description: Time that replica takes from full lock to full lock.

value.description: Your prediction: a finite number in the unit of the quantity.

derived.description: Exactly the 7 derived ids. Each holds your prediction of one quantity of procedure.py for a replica built to your own BOM, under the conditions of submission_contract.md, section 2.2.

source_id.description: A source id. It names one given document or picture: B-01 to B-16 (items of brief.md), BL-01 to BL-10 (entries of build_log.md), PH-01 to PH-33 (photographs), DS-.. (datasheet pages), ER-. (erratum notices), LR-. (lot reports). Only an id that exists is accepted.

sources.description: The source ids of the places where the value can be read: at most 16.

unit.description: The unit string, written exactly as submission_contract.md prints it for this id.
